integrity: The proof is analytical, finite checks use a standalone standard-library program, and no independent audit or priority certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: The result applies only to spatially homogeneous one-directional nearest-neighbor walks with holding and to iid random-mapping grand couplings.
No full-text comparison with the earlier 2019 preprint/2021 chapter was possible; automata-semigroup priority remains a risk.
Finite semigroup enumeration is diagnostic and does not replace the general proof.
title: Divisor spectrum and balanced coalescence for lazy directed cycles
